one_line: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid scandals, while Anthropic launched meeting notes and Amazon planned an AI product graph.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
themes.text: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after admitting to personal relationships, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. The board is searching for a successor amid regulatory inquiries into China chip sales and concerns from startup investors over past GPU financing strategies.

themes.title: New tools support AI shopping and meetings
themes.text: Amazon drafted plans for a World Product Graph to index global items for AI agents. Meanwhile, Anthropic launched Claude Meetings for real-time video call note-taking and documentation.
